mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals a shift toward monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand environment that triggers corporate earnings concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates robust supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), rising interest rates and persistent inflation reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates policy response to inflation that creates uncertainty about future monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase by at least 0.2 percentage points from the prior month.
